checks.name: initial
checks.simulation: Matching vvp passed all 256 eight-bit sequences, all 12 transitions, reset from all six states for both w values, reset priority and synchronous timing

limitations: Development PASS does not establish official correctness; no official evaluation was accessed.
The original problem does not specify reset polarity or destination. Implementation and development checks assume active-high synchronous reset to A; this is recorded in the frozen contract.
The original problem specifies no power-up state. RTL has no initialization and the testbench does not constrain pre-reset output.
